text:
support-jen: FYI @eng-oncall @sre-matt — AcmeCorp is seeing a spike of 503s + client timeouts hitting hosted inference since ~09:20 UTC. Customer reports SDK retry churn and unexpected billing. Repro attached below.

acme-rep: Seeing ~60% of requests returning 503 around 09:20–09:35. SDK shows backoff/retry waterfall, traffic doubles because client keeps retrying. Can you confirm root cause?

customer-bot: logs:
```
[2026-03-17T09:22:11Z] req_id=rcp_1a2b3c status=503 gateway="upstream_unavailable" model=gpt-open-2 size=652ms
[2026-03-17T09:22:12Z] req_id=rcp_1a2b3d status=timeout client_wait=12000ms
[2026-03-17T09:22:13Z] req_id=rcp_1a2b3e status=503 gateway="pool_exhausted" model=gpt-open-2
```

eng-oncall: Thanks. Can you paste a raw request and the SDK version? Also any headers you can share (Auth/Content-Type/Retry headers).

acme-rep: SDK: acme-sdk-js v2.4.1 (they're using our node SDK). Sample call: `client.generate({ model: 'gpt-open-2', input: 'summarize...' })`. They didn't set any explicit retry/backoff config.

devex-lee: This looks like "retrystorm" — client retries amplify a transient upstream capacity pressure. Our hosted edge is returning 503s when the model pool gets saturated, and naive client retries are making it worse. SDK v2.4.1 default is 5 retries with linear backoff — that's pretty aggressive for tail 503 spikes.

sre-matt: Agree. Quick mitigations: 1) tell the customer to set SDK max_retries=1 and enable exponential backoff; 2) we can enable a short-lived global retry-shedding policy on the edge to return 429 for repeated replays from same client, to reduce thundering herd.

support-jen: Acme is asking for step-by-step. Drafting suggested customer steps below — please sanity-check before I send: 
- Set env var REDWOOD_SDK_MAX_RETRIES=1 or SDK option maxRetries=1
- Use exponential backoff: base=250ms, max=2000ms
- Add idempotency key header `X-Acme-Idempotency: <uuid>` for non-chat endpoints
- If still seeing 503s, route traffic to a lower-throughput model (gpt-open-2 -> gpt-open-1) while we investigate.

eng-oncall: Good. Also include temporary increase to client-side connect/response timeout so the SDK doesn't treat slow tail as immediate retry (e.g., timeout=30s). I'll open an infra ticket to check model pool health and autoscaler behavior.

sre-matt: INF ticket opened: INF-9876 — investigating pool depletion during 09:18–09:36 UTC. Initial hypothesis: autoscaler lag + some long-run requests held slots. I'll attach pod/instance counts and GC logs when I have them.

devex-lee: For long term, we should: a) change SDK default retries to exponential and lower default max, b) add client guidance doc for retry patterns in high-throughput inference, c) consider server-side Retry-After for brief capacity shedding.

acme-rep: Sending proposed patch to customers: will apply SDK tweak + idempotency keys and test. Will update you in ~15m with results.

support-jen: Patch text I plan to send: "Hi — sorry about the disruption. Please set maxRetries=1 and exponential backoff (250ms -> 2s), add an idempotency key for duplicate-safe requests, and temporarily switch to gpt-open-1 if your latency tolerance allows. We're investigating on our side and will follow up in 30 minutes with infra findings." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

eng-oncall: :thumbsup: Looks good. Add note to avoid aggressive parallel retries (limit concurrent requests client-side to N=8).

sre-matt: Update: infra shows model pool hit 100% for gpt-open-2 at 09:21:30 UTC; autoscaler began provisioning but new instances only registered ~60s later. There were ~4 long-running requests >25s that blocked slots. INF-9876 includes request_id list and instance allocation timeline.

acme-rep: After changing SDK to maxRetries=1 + exponential backoff, error rate dropped to ~6% and billing spike stopped within 7 minutes. Thanks.

support-jen: Sending customer update now. Will keep thread open until INF-9876 has full postmortem.

devex-lee: Small follow-up: We should push a warning in SDK docs about default retry settings and a sample config block: 
```
// recommended
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxRetries: 1,
  retryBackoffBaseMs: 250,
  retryBackoffMaxMs: 2000,
  timeoutMs: 30000,
  maxConcurrentRequests: 8
});
```

sre-matt: Adding to INF ticket: investigate autoscaler thresholds and whether we can pre-warm during predictable bursts. Also adding a short-term edge policy to return 429 for repeated same-client bursts.

support-jen: Marking this thread as "customer temporarily mitigated". Will post final postmortem once INF-9876 is done. cc @acme-rep :wave:

acme-rep: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick response.

eng-oncall: Closing loop for now. If Acme sees recurrence, we'll escalate to priority SE meeting.

support-jen: (internal note) follow-up checklist: send SDK doc PR, confirm INF-9876 postmortem includes timeline + action items, announce edge retry-shedding change to ops.
